changes.mainBotWelcome: Removed introduction and duties paragraphs; illustration, tagline and composer remain.

companion.automaticPosition: 16 DIP to the right of composer, lower edges aligned; follows measured geometry after move/resize settles.
companion.manualDrag: Stops automatic following until reset or next application launch.
companion.reset: Returns to default composer-relative position and resumes automatic following.
companion.narrowWindow: Moves above the right edge of the composer if the gutter cannot contain the full character.
companion.redundantPlacement: Same bounds do not call setContentBounds; bursts coalesce after 150ms; no new placement polling.

startup.layout: Proportional cover with centered edge cropping, preserving progress and status.

checks: packaged product main Bot and primary create action are visible
main Bot welcome preserves the tagline without the introduction or duties paragraphs
original creation dialog saves two ordinary Bots in the Bot section
group creation saves a separate group sidebar entry and a clean group composer

limitations: Installer was not executed or installed, and actual user data was not read or changed.
Product UI used the archived Host and an isolated hidden browser with zero model calls; it was not the installed Electron shell.
Startup renders used isolated Electron static documents; native companion positioning used focused geometry/IPC tests, not a hardware compositor paint-count measurement.
